hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored ljungBoxTest reproduces statsmodels.stats.diagnostic.acorr_ljungbox BIT-FOR-BIT for both the Q statistic and the p-value; and the test decisively rejects the white-noise null (Q far above the 95% chi-square critical value).

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: ljungBoxTest equals statsmodels acorr_ljungbox to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9 for statistic and p-value); Q exceeds the 95% critical value
